title: Great day in Las Alpujarras!
text: Jose was amazing. Very friendly and knowledgable of the area. He tailored the tour to what we wanted (small villages, ham factory, chocolate and olive oil tastings) and was very kind with our kids.
author: jenjohns513

title: Jaime - excellent guide!!
text: Jaime was an excellent guide. He was very knowledgeable of the villages we visited, the area of the Sierra Nevadas and nature and history. He is very personable and speaks very good English. We highly recommend him. If you are interested in mountain hiking he is your person. He is passionate about the outdoors and has many years of experience.
author: Kathy_P

title: Wonderful day out in nature
text: An amazing experience with wonderful views! We visited the beautiful villages along the mountains. Luis our guide was amazing and we had a great day! Would definitely recommend for anyone visiting Granada for sure
author: 419432de

title: The Best Tour
text: Mike was an amazing tour guide! We were able to customize the trip and he knew exactly where to take us for the different things we wanted to see and experience. He did not rush us at all and we had an absolutely blast. No better way to end our trip! I highly recommend anyone considering this to book it!
author: Stay08933374176

title: Sierra Nevada experience
text: Spend an extra day in Granada and book this tour into the white villages of Sierra Nevada where the Muslims of Granada retreated after the expulsion of 1492. Maika drove us through mountains on winding roads and we visited 3 communities, walked the cobbled streets, admired the unique homes and gardens,  explored the interior of a historic home and church, enjoyed a coffee break and a delicious lunch. Listened to the burbling mountain streams, waterfalls and bird song, admired the views. Maika's love for this geography is evident and she is a wonderful guide who gave us a deeper appreciation of
author: Planet_13

title: A day trip we enjoyed so much!
text: How can you understand Spain until you get far away from the cities to villages with 500-700 people up in the mountains? This trip was well worth it. We learned so much about the history of the region from Maika, our guide!
author: Richard_L

title: Great Day in the Mountains
text:
The trip to the Alpujarras was a highlight of our vacation!  The pace of the day was perfect for us and our two young boys (7 and 5).  We all enjoyed walking thorugh the villages, learning about the history and getting to know our guide, Jaime.  
Jaime was an outstanding guide and we would definitely recommend this trip!
author: sarahsJ3742ND

title: Relaxed private tour
text: We enjoyed the cute, handmade white little houses with unique chimney tops and the natural water fountains and the views of the Sierra Nevada and the valleys. Our guide Michael made the trip memorable and explained the culture, lifestyle, and history of the area in an easy to understand way. Also he reserved a great place for lunch and suggested a delicious local Migas dish for us.
author: Randolph_C

title: Great excursion with great guide.
text: Our guide Michael was very friendly, spoke English very well and was very nice to our 14 year old grandson.  We were very lucky to be the only people on the tour.  It was a good experience that we all enjoyed.
author: Thomas_F

title: Gorgeous day and beautiful views
text: Pedro brought us to the Alpujarras Mountains and we had a beautiful relaxing day. We hiked, walked the streets of the villages and had a delicious lunch. Pedro was very personable, patient with my children (who enjoyed the hike too) and just a pleasure to converse with all day. Definitely recommend this trip!
author: Navigate315415
